g.title: Sheet.180
g.desc: Vertical Scaling Expanding the capacity of a single device by...
g.text: Vertical ScalingExpanding the capacity of a single device by upgrading its hardware — adding more ports, increasing link speeds, moving to a larger chassis, etc.

g.title: Sheet.181
g.desc: Horizontal Scaling Expanding the capacity of the network by a...
g.text: Horizontal ScalingExpanding the capacity of the network by adding more devices and spreading the load — adding more leaf switches with all links active and traffic balanced.
